services.docker_compose_raw:
services:
  web:
    image: 'nginx:alpine'
    environment:
      - 'FOO=${FOO:-bar}'
  db:
    image: 'postgres:16-alpine'
    environment:
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD}'
services.docker_compose:
services:
  web:
    image: 'nginx:alpine'
    environment:
      FOO: bar
  db:
    image: 'postgres:16-alpine'
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: dbSecretPass1

proxy configuration: save
setup: update server_settings set is_reachable = true, is_usable = true where server_id = 1

body.configuration:
name: coolify-proxy
networks:
  coolify:
    external: true
services:
  traefik:
    container_name: coolify-proxy
    image: 'traefik:v3.6'
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - coolify
    ports:
      - '80:80'
      - '443:443'
      - '443:443/udp'
      - '8080:8080'
    labels:
      - coolify.managed=true

after.server: select (case when proxy is null or (proxy::jsonb -> 'redirect_enabled') is null then coalesce(proxy::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) || '{"redirect_enabled": true}'::jsonb else proxy::jsonb end)::text as proxy, proxy_error_page, detected_traefik_version, ip, ip_previous from servers where id = 1
